title: Tim Taylor and the 'adjustment team'

tellings.quote: And then there's Tim Taylor telling Pasulka that he was part of the quote-unquote adjustment team,

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor, linked to the US space agency NASA, is said to have told the religion scholar Diana Pasulka that he was part of what he called the "adjustment team." Michels repeats this as something Taylor told Pasulka, putting the phrase in quotation marks and not explaining what the team did. He raises it among hints that NASA has a hidden side tied to the UFO question.
